s: Din erubin leir ubo t' seipim: ir shehayeta qinyan yachid, shebbenaah yachid leatzmo sheyyaskirenna lerabbim, sheen zo doma kelal lirshut harabbim gemura — im hikshiru mebooteha kehilkatam belechi o qora o tzurat petach o bidlatot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"d, hare hem yekolim lehishtattep kullam shittup echad vitaltelu bekol hair. Veenam tzerikim leshayyer mimmenna kelum apillu naaset shel rabbim, shemmekarah achar kak lerabbim. Veken im benaah lehoshib bah diyyurin, veshiyyer leatzmo derakim upelatyot kederek shehammelakim osim — hare zo ir shel yachid, umishtattepim kullam shittup echad (apillu mekarah achar kak lerabbim). Veken im hayeta shel rabbim meolam, veen lah ella petach echad — en zo doma lirshut harabbim, umishtattepin kullam shittup echad. Abal im hayeta shel rabbim veyesh lah b' petachim, shehaam niknasim bezo veyotzeim bezo, shehi doma lirshut harabbim — ap al pi shehikshiru mebooteha kehilkoteha, en meorbin et kullah apillu naaset achar kak shel yachid, ki shemma tachazor veteaseh shel rabbim, ella meshayyerin mimmenna maqom echad, apillu bayit echad, umishtattepim hashshear. Veyihyu ellu hammishtattepim muttarim bekol hair chutz meoto maqom sheshshiyyeru, sheasurim lehotzi lesham kelim sheshshabetu bebattehem. Veyihyu otam hannisharim muttarim bimqomam beshittup sheosim leatzmam im hem rabbim, vaasurim bishar kol hair bekelim sheshshabetu bebattehem. Vedabar zeh mishshum hekker hu, kede sheyyedeu shehaerub hittir lahem letaltel beir zo, sherabbim boqeim bah vedoma lirshut harabbim, shehare hammaqom shennishar shello nishtattep immahem en metaltelin bo ella ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. Abal im lo haya shiyyur — haya haerub mishtakkeach, vehayeta mishtakkachat torat reshut harabbim al yede sheroin shemmetaltelin beir zo haddoma lirshut harabbim. Uledibre haomerim shekkol reshut harabbim sheen s' ribbo boqein bah bekol yom enah reshut harabbim gemura, shebbepachot mis' ribbo enah niqret beqiat rabbim — en tzarik laasot shiyyur leir shel rabbim, ella im ken shishshim ribbo boqeim bah bekol yom. Veal zeh somekin akshav, sheen nohagin laasot shiyyur leshum ir:

Ir shel rabbim sheyyesh lah petach echad, vesullam bemaqom acher bechomatah — en hassullam shebbachoma nechshab kepetach lehatzrikah shiyyur, shehassullam eno nechshab kepetach ella lehaqel abal lo lehachamir, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"h. Vaapillu heemid harbeh sullamot zeh betzad zeh berochab yoter meeser — enam mebattelim hachoma asher sham mittorat mechitztza. Veim yesh lah shene petachim, veyesh ashpa lipne echad mehem (shemmonaat beqiat harabbim sham) — hare zo keillu en lah ella petach echad:

Habbattim shemmannichim otam shiyyur lair — ap al pi sheenam petuchim lair ella achorehem lair upenehem lechutz, veen lahem challonot lair, sheapillu im ratzu lehishtattep yachad, enan yekolim. Vaapillu hu raq bayit echad, vaapillu hu bet habbaqar o bet hatteben sheen tzarik leareb kelal — osim otam shiyyur umeorbim et hashshear. Abal batte hannokrim — yesh omerim sheenam moilim laasotam shiyyur lair, veyesh mattirin:

Ir shennishtattepu kol yoshebeha chutz mimmaboy echad, hare zeh oser al kullam. Veim banu itzteba geboha d' tepachim al petach hammaboy — eno oser alehem, shehare silleq atzmo millehishtammesh bimbootehem. Veap al pi sheober bahem beshabbat, en haabara beregel bilbad oseret, kevan shessilleq atzmo mittashmish, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"v. Abal im nishtattepu kol hammeboot, ap al pi shello nishtattepu yachad ella maboy maboy bipne atzmo — enan oserim zeh al zeh, mippene shehi regel hammutteret bimqomah veenah oseret shello bimqomah behaabara bilbad, kevan sheenah mishtammeshet sham beshabbat, shehare lo ereba immahem. Ukeshemmeorbin maboy maboy bipne atzmo en tzarik leshayyer kelum, sheen leka shiyyur gadol mizzeh — shekkol echad naaseh shiyyur lachabero. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beir shehayeta shel rabbim meolam, shemmeolam hutzreku leshiyyur. Abal ir shehayeta shel yachid, apillu naaset shel rabbim, kevan sheen tzerikin leshiyyur vehurgelu leareb kol hammeboot yachad beshittup echad — hare naasu kullam kemaboy echad, vei epshar lahem lechaleq uleareb maboy maboy bipne atzmo, ella im ken yibneh kol echad itzteba al pitcho lachaloq reshuto mehem kede shello yeesor al kullam:

Vaapillu ir shehayeta shel rabbim meolam, im hi muqqepet choma gaboah y' tepachim veyesh lah delatot lehattir reshut harabbim shebbetokah — en meorbin otah lachatzain leorkah, dehaynu shemmeboot shebbetzad zeh shel reshut harabbim yearebu erub echad vehammeboot shebbetzad hab' yearebu erub echad. Vaapillu bene tzad haechad rotzim litten kol reshut harabbim letzad hab', shehem yishtammeshu bah beshabbat mibbattehem velo hem — en zeh moil kelum, shehare gam hem tzerikim laabor birshut harabbim beshabbat, veoserim otah al bene tzad hab' bidrisat raglam. Vehu haddin apillu bene maboy echad en yekolim lachaloq hammaboy leorko, shebbene tzad zeh yearebu leatzman ubene tzad zeh leatzman, kevan sheshshenehem oberim bo beshabbat, veoserim zeh al zeh bidrisat raglam kol shello sillequ atzman mittashmish, dehaynu sheyyibneh kol echad itzteba al petach chatzero, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"v. Abal yekolim lachaloq hair lerochab, dehaynu sheb' hatztzedadim shel reshut harabbim sheetzel petach zeh meorbin leatzman, ub' hatztzedadim sheetzel petach hashsheni meorbin leatzman. Ubilbad sheyyaasu tzurat petach beemtza reshut harabbim o beemtza hammaboy, bemaqom shemmitchalleqim beeruban, kede lachaloq reshut zo mizzo, shello tehe kol achat perutza bemilluah lemaqom haasur lah, shehare ellu asurim lehishtammesh mibbattehem lekan veellu asurim lekan, kevan shello erebu yachad. Veim emtza hammaboy o emtza reshut harabbim bemaqom shemmitchalleqim sham eno rachab yoter meeser ammot — day bepas rachab d' tepachim o b' passin shel b' mashshehuyin, shehem moilim lechalleq reshuyyot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g. Abal itzteba enah moelet bimqom derisat harabbim. (Ukesheasu tzurat petach o b' passin mashshehuyin o pas d', venechlequ reshut zo mizzo, azay ap al pi sheoberim zeh al zeh beshabbat — en bekak kelum, mippene shezzeh domeh leb' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, sheppenimit shehi regel hammutteret bimqomah enah oseret al hachitzona bidrisat raglah bilbad belo tashmish, hoil veiqqar tashmish hachitzona hu libne hachitzona, veap al pi shehappenimit yesh lah gam ken reshut lehishtammesh ba bechol, mikkol maqom kevan sheakshav beshabbat mistalleqet hi millehishtammesh bechitzona, mippene shello ereba immah — hare zeh moil leshello teesor al hachitzona behaabara beregel bilbad, hoil veen tashmish hachitzona shaveh lishnehem, ella hu libne hachitzona yoter millibne happenimit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"v. Ap kan, kevan shennechlequ reshuyyot, ubene reshut zo silleqo atzman lehishtammesh birshut zo beshabbat — hare zeh moil, hoil veenan shavot lishnehem, shekkol achat hi tzerika leotam haddarim sham veenah tzerika kol kak lehaddarim etzel reshut hashsheniyya, shehare yesh lahem reshut shellipnehem sheyyekolim lehishtammesh bah kol cheptzam, veyesh lahem gam ken petach latzet bo im yirtzu. Lepikak en otam sheen darim sham oserim al haddarim sham bidrisat raglam bilbad. Vaapillu maboy sheen lo ella petach echad, vachalaquhu lerochbo betzurat petach o bepassin — en happenimim oserim al hachitzonim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g, mippene sheddomeh leb' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, shettashmish hachitzona eno shaveh lishnehem. Mah sheen ken keshechalaquhu leorko, shettashmish hammaboy shebbaemtza hu shaveh libne b' hatztzedadim — laken hem oserim zeh al zeh apillu bidrisat regel bilbad, ap al pi shessillequ atzman mittashmish mechamat shello erebu, ad sheyyaasu silluq bemaaseh, dehaynu itzteba al petach kol chatzer vechatzer, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"v). Veken kesheosin shiyyur leir shel rabbim, im hashshiyyur eno maboy shalem ella meshayyerim miqtzato bilbad, shemmeareb leatzmo — tzerikim lachaloq sham reshuyyot betzurat petach o bepassin im eno rachab yoter meeser. Vaapillu beir shel yachid moilim passin vetzurat petach lachaloq reshuyyot, sheyyearebu ellu leatzman veellu leatzman, ap al pi shehurgelu kebar leareb yachad shittup echad. Abal lechi veqora shebbepitche hammeboot, ap al pi shehem moilim lehakshir hammeboot — enan moilim lechalleqam ulesalleqam zeh mizzeh leinyan erub, sheyyearebu ellu leatzman veellu leatzman beir shel yachid, o apillu beir shel rabbim leinyan sheim maboy echad lo shittep apillu leatzmo shello yeesor al kullam belo itzteba:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkol hammeboot hem muksharim bimchitztzot kehilkatan, ben shehikshiram al yede lechi o qora, ben shehem beinyan sheenam tzerikim letiqqun kelal, kegon ir hammuqqepet choma veyesh lah delatot, sheen mebooteha tzerikim tiqqun. Abal ir shemmebooteha tzerikim tiqqun — yekolim lehakshir miqtzat meboot hair ulehanniach hashshear belo tiqqun, veen hammeboot sheenam metuqqanim oserim al hammetuqqanim, apillu en benehem tzurat petach o passin ella lechi o qora. Vaapillu hi ir shel yachid umittechilla hurgelu leareb erub echad, shehayu kol hammeboot metuqqanim veachar kak nipretzu. Vaapillu maboy echad yekolim lechalleq lerochbo al yede lechi sheyyaamidu beemtzaito, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g, veen shear bene hammaboy shechutz lallechi oserim al happenimit mechamat shello erebu immahem, kevan shehachitzonim asurim letaltel bammaboy vei epshar lahem leareb kelal. (Umittaam zeh apillu im hammeboot sheenam metuqqanim yesh lahem derisat regel al hammetuqqanim enam oserim alehem, kevan sheenan yekolim leareb immahem. Vehu haddin im kullam metuqqanim ella shemmapsiq benehem maqom haasur betiltul mechamat sheeno muqqap mechitztzot kehilkatan, ap al pi shemmiqtzatam lo erebu — en oserim. Velo ameru sheregel haasura bimqomah oseret shello bimqomah ella bb' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, sheyyekolot leareb yachad). Veir hammuqqepet choma veyesh lah delatot ninalim, raq shebbepetach echad en lah delet, vegam en sham mashqop, sheyyehe niddon mishshum tzurat petach, ella mezuzot bilbad — hare mezuzot ellu enan geruim millechi shemmoil limboot hammepullashim lirshut harabbim. Veim ken im en bair reshut harabbim, ap al pi shemmebooteha mepullashim lisratya shehi reshut harabbim — hare hi nitteret belechi shemmikkan udelatot shemmikkan, veshub en shear mebooteha tzerikim tiqqun. Vei epshar lahem lechaleq beerubam ella al derek shennitbaer. Veim yesh bah pirtza haoseret — batel heksherah, vikolim leareb chetzyah ulehanniach chetzyah beli heksher:

(Vekol zeh keshebbene hammeboot oberim zeh al zeh beshabbat. Abal b' meboot happetuchim zeh lezeh upetuchim gam ken lirshut harabbim, sherotzim lehistalleq zeh mizzeh shello laabor zeh al zeh beshabbat ella kol echad yelek lirshut harabbim derek pitcho — yesh omerim sheyyekolim leareb kol echad leatzmo, ap al pi sheen benehem tzurat petach o passin ella lechi o qora, im en sham rochab yoter meeser, shekkevan sheenan oberim zeh al zeh — enan oserim zeh al zeh, kemo shehechatzer happetucha lammaboy veenah oberet bo beshabbat enah oseret im yesh lah petach acher lemaboy acher, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"v. Ulepi zeh, im maboy echad ereb leatzmo vehashsheni lo ereb kelal — kopin oto al middat sedom shello yaabor beshabbat al zeh sheereb kede shello yeesor alayv, kevan sheyyesh lo petach acher latzet lirshut harabbim, kemo shekkopin et hechatzer shello ereba bammaboy shello taabor bo beshabbat im yesh lah petach lemaboy acher laabor derek alayv lirshut harabbim, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veen tzarik lomar im erebu b' hammeboot zeh leatzmo vezeh leatzmo, ubeshabbat ba echad laabor al chabero, sheyyakol leakkeb alayv, kevan shekkebar gilla dato shessilleq derisat raglo meal chabero bemah sheereb leatzmo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beir shemmebooteha tzerikim tiqqun, vetiqqune meboot ellu betzurat petach letzad reshut harabbim velechi o qora benehem kedin maboy aqom shennitbaer besimman shs"d. Abal ir hammuqqepet choma beinyan sheen mebooteha tzerikim tiqqun, mippene shennaaset kullah kechatzer achat shel rabbim kemo shennitbaer — enan yekolim lachaloq mebooteha, leareb ellu leatzman veellu leatzman, ella betzurat petach o bepassin, kemi sherotzeh lachaloq chatzer achat lishtayim. Abal lechi veqora enan moilot apillu im lo yaabru zeh al zeh beshabbat, sheenan oserim bidrisat raglam, mikkol maqom oserim zeh et zeh bemah shekkol echad parutz bemilluo lemaqom haasur lo, shehare asur letaltel mibbatte maboy zeh lemaboy acher shello ereb immo. Uletaqqen pirtzat chatzer tzarik tzurat petach o passin, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g. Mah sheen ken ir shemmebooteha tzerikot tiqqun — azay kol maboy hammetuqqan bepitcho belechi o qora yesh torat petach alayv, velo shem pirtza, lepikak moil bo silluq derisat haregel, kemo shemmoil bechatzer happetucha kemo shennitbaer):
Ir shel rabbim shennitmaata veomda al chamishshim diyyurin — meorbin kullah veen tzarik shiyyur:

Hamzakkeh beshittup lekol bene hair, im meareb erub echad lekullam — eno tzarik lehodia lahem, shezzekut hu lahem. Vedin mi sheshshakach velo nishtattep im bene hair, o mi shehalak lishbot beir acheret, o nokri sheddar immahem bair — din hakkol kedinam bechatzer ubemaboy:
